prompt_en: Use <Picture 1> as the source image. Apply the user's requested local edit only to the specified area. Preserve identity, subject count, composition, pose, perspective, lighting, texture, shadows, and every unrequested part of the image. Make the edited boundary and surrounding details natural and consistent.
prompt_cn: 使用 <Picture 1> 作为源图。只在用户指定的区域执行局部修改，保持人物身份、主体数量、构图、姿态、透视、光照、纹理、阴影以及画面中所有未要求修改的内容不变，让修改边界和周围细节自然一致。

prompt_en: Use <Picture 1> as the source image. Remove only the user-specified object and reconstruct the exposed area with matching perspective, texture, lighting, reflections, shadows, and occlusion. Preserve the subject, composition, and every other visible detail.
prompt_cn: 使用 <Picture 1> 作为源图。只移除用户指定的物体，并按照原有透视、纹理、光照、反射、阴影和遮挡关系自然修复暴露区域。保持主体、构图以及其他所有可见细节不变。

prompt_en: Use <Picture 1> as the source image. Replace only the background with the user's requested setting while preserving the main subject's identity, face, hairstyle, clothing, pose, silhouette, proportions, foreground details, and contact lighting. Match the new background to the subject's perspective, depth, and light direction.
prompt_cn: 使用 <Picture 1> 作为源图。只替换背景为用户指定的场景，保持主体身份、脸部、发型、服装、姿态、轮廓、比例、前景细节和接触光照不变，并让新背景与主体的透视、景深和光照方向自然匹配。

prompt_en: Use <Picture 1> as the target image and <Picture 2> as the clothing reference. Transfer only the requested garment design, cut, color, material, texture, decorations, and layering from <Picture 2> to the person in <Picture 1>. Preserve the target identity, face, hair, body proportions, pose, background, and lighting, with natural folds, occlusion, contact shadows, and fit.
prompt_cn: 使用 <Picture 1> 作为目标图，使用 <Picture 2> 作为服装参考。只将 <Picture 2> 中用户指定的服装版型、颜色、材质、纹理、装饰和层次迁移到 <Picture 1> 的人物身上，保持目标人物身份、脸部、发型、身体比例、姿态、背景和光照不变，并让褶皱、遮挡、接触阴影和贴合关系自然可信。

prompt_en: Use <Picture 1> as the target image and <Picture 2> as the style and lighting reference. Transfer only the requested visual style, palette, lighting direction, material treatment, and atmosphere from <Picture 2> while preserving the target subject, identity, pose, composition, scene content, and unrequested details in <Picture 1>.
prompt_cn: 使用 <Picture 1> 作为目标图，使用 <Picture 2> 作为风格和光照参考。只将 <Picture 2> 中用户指定的视觉风格、色彩、光照方向、材质处理和氛围迁移到目标图，同时保持 <Picture 1> 的主体、身份、姿态、构图、场景内容以及其他未要求修改的细节不变。

prompt_en: Use <Picture 1> as the target image and <Picture 2> as the pose reference. Transfer only the requested pose, gesture, limb angles, and body orientation from <Picture 2> to the person in <Picture 1>. Preserve the target identity, face, hairstyle, clothing, body proportions, style, composition, and lighting, with anatomically coherent hands, feet, balance, shadows, and scene contact.
prompt_cn: 使用 <Picture 1> 作为目标图，使用 <Picture 2> 作为姿态参考。只将 <Picture 2> 中用户指定的姿态、手势、肢体角度和身体朝向迁移到 <Picture 1> 的人物身上，保持目标身份、脸部、发型、服装、身体比例、画风、构图和光照不变，并确保手脚、重心、阴影以及与场景的接触关系自然可信。

prompt_en: Use <Picture 1> as the product reference and <Picture 2> as the scene reference. Place the product from <Picture 1> naturally into the requested scene based on <Picture 2>, preserving its shape, branding, material, color, proportions, and readable details. Match scale, perspective, reflections, contact shadows, occlusion, lighting, and depth to the scene.
prompt_cn: 使用 <Picture 1> 作为商品参考，使用 <Picture 2> 作为场景参考。根据 <Picture 2> 将 <Picture 1> 中的商品自然放入用户指定的场景，保持商品形状、品牌标识、材质、颜色、比例和可读细节不变，并让尺度、透视、反射、接触阴影、遮挡、光照和景深与场景一致。

prompt_en: Use <Picture 1> and <Picture 2> as independent identity references. Place both people in the requested scene with natural spacing, eye lines, scale, pose relationship, and interaction while preserving each person's identity, face, hairstyle, clothing, body proportions, lighting, shadows, and the requested composition.
prompt_cn: 使用 <Picture 1> 和 <Picture 2> 作为相互独立的身份参考。将两位人物放入用户指定的场景，安排自然的站位、视线、尺度、姿态关系和互动，同时保持双方身份、脸部、发型、服装、身体比例、光照、阴影以及用户指定的构图不变。
